verdict.rationale: Column's first-party docs show sending and receiving domestic wires over Fedwire, plus sending, receiving and request-for-payment over both FedNow and RTP. These rails sit in one API that also has a unified transfers endpoint, and each rail has its own documentation page. missing for 10: detailed per-rail capability comparison (limits, operating hours, rail-specific differences between RTP and FedNow) evidenced in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time rail usage.

support.subject: As a developer, the faster rails are there when I need them — domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination and receipt through the same API, with per-rail capabilities documented

citations.quote: Column exposes the ability to transmit and receive wires through the Federal Reserve's Fedwire system.
Column enables you to immediately send funds, receive funds, and request payment (RFP) through both the Federal Reserve's FedNow Service and The Clearing House's RTP® network.
Query transfers across all payment types from a single unified endpoint.
You can access the raw message for domestic wires using our get wire transfer API endpoint
